HEALTH SWEEP both boxes. VPS 68 checks 0 RED 0 AMBER 0 UNKNOWN (first fully clean run). Laptop 65 checks 1 RED 1 AMBER 0 UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN now 0 on both boxes.

FIXED VPS ledger ACLs: 5 learning ledgers had been unwritable 17h (EPERM). RunLevel=Limited tasks lose append every time a git pull recreates the tracked file. Granted Users:(R,W) - no DELETE - plus ObjectInherit on tasks\ so it survives a pull. Verified surviving a real pull.

ADDED .gitattributes tasks/*.jsonl merge=union. Negative control proved git otherwise writes <<<<<<< markers INTO the ledger, which breaks every per-line JSON.parse reader. Never extend to *.json.

HARDENED autohealer: preserveCorrupt() keeps <file>.corrupt-<stamp> before overwriting a corrupt learning.json/journal.json. Proven by really corrupting files in a scratch harness. TAKES EFFECT AT NEXT SERVER START.

FIXED TradingView collision: the two boxes were already an hour apart by timezone; the cause was the VPS trigger PT20M for PT23H (~69 runs/day) running over whatever the laptop drew. Split per box - VPS 04:45-11:45 UTC, laptop 12:15-23:15 UTC (laptop given a repeat because it sleeps). VPS now rc=0 'plan drawn on all charts'.
ANSWER on auto-healing: not broken - it has NEVER FIRED. healCount 0, lastHealAt null on both boxes, and autohealer.js:504 says nothing reads state.healthy. Untested, not healthy.

OPEN / HIS DECISION: laptop research bars are 1-3 days behind the VPS because Refresh Bars has refused 217 times while SP500 BUY 0.1 has been open since 2026-08-19 (20 days). Refusing is correct - forcing opens a 2nd MT5 client and can drop the bridge. Same position is the 1.184 R:R below the 1.5 floor. Closing or reducing it clears bar drift + parity RED + R:R amber together.

2026-09-08, 14 commits, both boxes at 38be04a. Two halves. HEALTH: five VPS learning ledgers had been unwritable for 17h because RunLevel=Limited tasks lose append rights every time a git pull recreates a tracked file; the VPS backup had captured 105 of ~13,700 files for FIVE DAYS because one filename ending in a trailing dot left a zip entry stream open and poisoned every write after it, while the log said "Backup created" and bucket_audit said "BOTH BUCKETS PRESENT AND FRESH"; the autohealer overwrote a corrupt learning.json/journal.json instead of preserving it; and boot context surfaced nothing about where the last session stopped, which is why every session started new. All fixed and verified by running them - the VPS coverage audit read 0 RED / 0 AMBER / 0 UNKNOWN for the first time, and the repaired backup went 1,003 KB / 105 files to 65,831 KB / 13,698 files. ENGINE, on owner instruction and against a walk-forward that disagrees: MACD_BULLISH_MODE flipped to "trend" and confidence went 0 to 40 on all three assets on both boxes; BREAKDOWN made reachable on a genuine fall instead of waiting for a 3-8% collapse; and the trend label now says out loud when it is EMA stacking with no ADX behind it, without changing the string that gates in four places. The flip started trading inside 90 minutes - two SP500 MOMENTUM longs at confidence 75, one closed +3.28 at realizedR 0.5, one still open. The most useful thing learned is not a fix: MOMENTUM is +0.37 avgRealizedR and 57.1% win rate yet -173.16 in dollars, because riskDollarsPerR spans 1.46 to 449.72 - the sizing, not the signal, is what eats the edge, and nothing changed today touches it. I also made four wrong claims during the session, all the same shape: reporting a conclusion before verifying the thing it rested on. Recorded so it is not repeated.
